notes: The workflow_deployment_name must match the deployed LIA v6 workflow name in Vellum. The API key is the assistant API key stored in the Vellum platform. To get execution status/logs, poll GET /v1/executions/{execution_id} or use webhook callbacks.

frontend_integration.on_click: POST to a backend route that proxies the Vellum API (never expose API key in frontend)
frontend_integration.log_display: Poll execution status, show node-by-node log output in a scrollable terminal
